# yasmin: the world around the record

Everything here is fictional. It exists so the data has somewhere to come
from: routes explain repeated distances, the calendar explains gaps, people
explain context values. The generator draws from these constants, so the
record and this file agree by construction.

## Household and people

- Ottawa, Canada. A two-bedroom rental five minutes from the kids' school.
- Divorced from Daniel in 2026; co-parenting on a strict week-on/week-off
  schedule that is the real clock behind this record, not the calendar
  week. Zara, 14, and Sami, 11.
- Sami's Saturday swim lessons run on her off-weeks; she still drives over
  to watch some of them. That is a real, recurring thing in her week and it
  never becomes a session row - she does not get in the water.
- Works in the city planning office. Drives everywhere; the winters make
  anything else impractical for her commute.

## Body and build

165 cm. Perimenopausal - the reason her sleep is what it is on certain
nights (`daily.jsonl`), never named as such anywhere data-facing in this
record. Weight has genuinely drifted upward across the three years even
though every attempt produces a real, modest improvement while it lasts.

## Transport and routine

Drives to work and to the school. The on-week has structure (school run,
dinner, the kids' evenings); the off-week does not, and that absence is
exactly when both the good habits and the bad ones show up or vanish.

## Places

- **Grocery**: Loblaws, whichever location is on the way home.
- **Gym**: membership parked through attempts 1 and 2 - there was no gym in
  either of those eras, only the home strength video and the walk. From
  October 2029 (attempt 3) she reactivates a basic-tier membership and
  splits her strength sessions between the gym circuit and the same home
  video, roughly two gym visits for every three home sessions.
- **Home**: the strength video, a fixed 28-to-42-minute routine, done in
  the living room.

## Route catalog

One walking route the whole record long, plus a gym circuit that only
exists once the membership does:

| Route | Distance | Shape | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| river path | 3.2 km | out and back | the one walk she never stops doing, on-week or off |
| gym circuit | n/a (indoor) | fixed stations | attempt 3 only, once the basic-tier membership resumes |

## Calendar and milestones

- 2027-07-02: the record opens on attempt 1's first on-week.
- 2027-11-04: attempt 1 ends after 18 weeks; the goal row admitting it is
  abandoned is not written until 2027-11-20 - she does not decide to stop,
  she just stops, and only names it weeks later.
- Roughly six months pass with nothing logged in any dataset.
- 2028-05-07: attempt 2 opens.
- 2028-08-12: attempt 2 ends after 14 weeks; abandoned on 2028-09-01.
- Roughly fourteen months pass with nothing logged in any dataset - the
  longer hole, and the one that does the most damage to the weight record
  (LIES.md Y1).
- 2029-10-01: attempt 3 opens, alongside the basic-tier gym membership.
  Still active on 2030-06-30, the record's last day.
- Kids-with-Daniel summer fortnights fall inside off-weeks each year and
  are not separately logged; they are simply more off-week.
- A college reunion, some time past this record's end, has a Facebook event
  page she opens and closes without RSVPing (`journal.jsonl`, 2030-02-02).
